name: Ormer's Revenge
summary: At Whelgar Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid and two companions are trapped above a raptor-swarmed dig. The dwarves uncovered massive prehistoric bones beneath the Wetlands, and the disturbance drew packs of mottled raptors that killed most of the crew.

sections.title: Unearthed Horrors
sections.body: The dwarves came to Whelgar Excavation Site to uncover the massive prehistoric remains beneath the Wetlands muck. Their discovery brought the marsh’s native raptors to the dig. Packs of mottled predators swarmed the site, caught the excavators off guard, and tore through their ranks.

sections.title: A Bitter Stand
sections.body: Only a handful of dwarves survived the slaughter. Ormer Ironbraid, Merrin Rockweaver, and Prospector Whelgar scrambled up a bluff above the pit, but aggressive packs still pin them there. Ormer is grieving and furious, yet stays to guard Merrin and the Prospector. He asks travelers to thin the Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers below, the opening salvo of his vengeance.

faq.q: What happened to the excavators here?
faq.answer: The raptors overran the dig after the dwarven archaeologists uncovered giant bones in the basin. The disturbance drew local packs from the marsh; they killed most of the crew and trapped three survivors on the high bluff.

Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven excavator stranded at Whelgar's Excavation Site. He stays to protect the shaken Prospector Whelgar and Merrin Rockweaver, while seeking bloody retribution against the raptors that killed his comrades.

faq.q: Where do these raptors come from?
faq.answer: Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are native Wetlands predators. They lurk on the muddy slopes and marshland west of the excavation bluff, and along paths leading toward the dig site's caves.

faq.q: Why doesn't Ormer hunt the raptors himself?
faq.answer: Ormer is eager to kill raptors himself, but he must guard Prospector Whelgar and Merrin Rockweaver. He keeps watch so the terrified dwarves' refuge on the bluff is not overrun.

faq.q: Does culling these raptors end Ormer's grudge?
aliases: is this the end of ormer's revenge
faq.answer: No. Killing the common Mottled Raptors and Screechers is only the first step in Ormer's plan to avenge his fallen friends. Harsher strikes against the raptor brood will follow.

faq.q: Why did uncovering the bones attract the raptors?
faq.answer: The Wetlands raptors are fiercely territorial and aggressive scavengers. Excavating the ancient giant remains disrupted the basin, drawing curious, hungry predators into the center of the dig camp.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing your kin slain during an Explorers' League dig can make clearing the raptor-infested quarry an act of ancestral honor and righteous retribution.
As a hunter, you can study how dangerous mottled raptors track through marsh terrain on the slopes outside the site.
